UC-001.Action: Configures global settings (Steam API Key, Telegram Token, Chat ID, Interval)
UC-001.Goal: To authenticate the bot and Steam watcher, and set polling frequency
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: Settings are securely saved in SQLite database

UC-002.Goal: To define whose Steam libraries to monitor
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Users are persisted in the database with their Name and SteamID

UC-003.Action: Clicks "Send Test Message" for a user
UC-003.Goal: To verify Telegram bot configuration and formatting
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: A fake game notification is sent to the Telegram chat with a [ТЕСТ] prefix and added to history

UC-004.Action: Periodically polls Steam API for all monitored users
UC-004.Goal: To detect newly added or purchased games
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: New games are detected, formatted gracefully (with pricing and tags), sent to Telegram, and saved to DB so they aren't repeated

UC-005.Action: Views the History page in Web UI
UC-005.Goal: To see a log of all previously sent Telegram notifications
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: History table displays the user, game name, timestamp, and test flag

UC-006.Action: Uses Telegram /price command for a game name or Steam appId
UC-006.Goal: To compare Steam RU, Steam KZ converted to RUB, and Plati.ru prices
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: Bot returns a formatted price card, handles multiple search results, and avoids non-Steam Plati.ru offers

UC-007.Action: Adds games to discount watchlist from Web UI or Telegram /watch command
UC-007.Goal: To receive Telegram notifications when a tracked game receives a new Steam discount
UC-007.AcceptanceCriteria: Watched games and price history are persisted; scheduled checks alert on discount transitions from 0% to a positive value

UC-008.Action: Checks Steam Store Search for 100% discounted free-to-keep games in RU and KZ
UC-008.Goal: To announce temporary free-to-keep promotions without repeating the same current promotion
UC-008.AcceptanceCriteria: Only appdetails-validated games are sent; DLC, free weekends, already-announced promotion keys, and games owned by all monitored users are skipped

UC-009.Action: Checks monitored users' Steam achievements for newly completed 100% games
UC-009.Goal: To congratulate users when they earn a "sunflower" perfect-achievement completion
UC-009.AcceptanceCriteria: Historical perfect games are baselined without spam; scheduled checks use owned-game and recently-played playtime diffs plus stale-state full scans before calling per-app achievement APIs; future completion transitions are deduplicated by completion key; manual tests can send the latest historical perfect game for a selected user
